> **Please note:** bnd is maintained by a small group of volunteers. Feature and enhancement requests are generally expected to be accompanied by a pull request. For larger changes, you may open an issue first to discuss the design before implementing it.

## Problem / Use case

What problem are you trying to solve? Please describe the use case rather than only the desired implementation. Why it is useful? Who benefits from the improvement or feature? etc.

## Proposed change

Briefly describe the behavior or functionality you would like to see.

## Alternatives considered

What alternatives or workarounds have you considered?

## Implementation

If you intend to implement this feature, please link to the pull request once available.

For larger or potentially architectural changes, please discuss the proposed approach before investing in a substantial implementation.

## Additional information

Add any other information, examples, or references that may help evaluate the proposal.
